notes.title: Angels Bleeding is now FREE
notes.content:
Hello fellow queers, 
Angels Bleeding was a tiny game I made back in late 2022 in about 4 months as an experiment on various things and to set up something else I've been working on since. 
Considering how small it was in scope I had always meant to make it free eventually once my situation allowed it but I never got around to it, so to celebrate the release of my most recent game [i]FlyKnight[/i] (of which I was the writer and producer), I decided it was about time.

I'm extremely proud of Angels Bleeding, with how much I managed to do with so little and everything I learned, but I'm also aware that it was fairly divisive, specially for 5€, so maybe this encourages more people who might've otherwise hesitated to just play it with an open mind and hopefully appreciate what I was going for.

BTW I'm comfortable leaving my previous game, Stars Die with its current pricing, so I don't imagine that one changing anytime soon. Also, go play FlyKnight, it's super cool!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3108510/FlyKnight/
